name: thesis-reward-cross-v1
headway_reward_mc: Chapter 3 ridge function with per-line forward/backward timetable targets and ratio-adjusted symmetry; hard 20-point large-deviation penalty. Evaluated at the next chronological decision using the unchanged v7 bounded observable headways; terminal reward zero.
settlement: MC: chronological global events including zero-duration simultaneous rows. Legacy/CS: global passenger-time increment between successive observations of the same vehicle, retaining their original transition interfaces. These cooperative intervals overlap; their rewards must not be summed to report system passenger time. Evaluation uses one independent system integral.
controls: Legacy ensemble SAC control disables both RE-SAC regularizers, preserving the ensemble, representation and budgets. CS no-NAU control retains the stabilizing package and removes the NAU actor. Full H2O+ enables ratio correction; h2o_matched disables it, matching the prior MC-WM backbone comparison.
selection: Final fixed-budget checkpoint only; five predeclared paired training seeds; report all seeds, no selection by test outcome. MC uses the ten pre-existing disjoint test cases only, not development selection.
preservation: Completed projects, original runners, offline HDF5 and old checkpoints remain unchanged. Relabel rewards only in the new replay instance, fit fresh offline prefixes per objective/seed, and refit all model reward heads. New outputs are separated by objective, method and seed. No claim of universal superiority or direct cross-environment ranking.
